taskVersion.name: ves-synthetic-a-item

parts.text:
You are preparing a groundwater site note for a borehole drilling team.

Curve-type notation for vertical electrical sounding (VES): take the layer resistivities in depth order. For each group of three consecutive layers (layers 1-2-3, then 2-3-4, and so on), write one letter: A if r1 < r2 < r3; Q if r1 > r2 > r3; H if r1 > r2 < r3; K if r1 < r2 > r3. A curve with N layers gets N-2 letters, in depth order (for example, a 4-layer curve gets 2 letters, such as HA). If all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter (AAA may be written A).

Station T-16, survey area T. Interpreted layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 312.0 | 6.08 | 6.08
2 | 794.3 | 14.76 | 20.84
3 | 884.4 | 3.48 | 24.32
4 | 1280.2 | 10.95 | 35.27
5 | 4929.0 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this station's curve as H-type.

Write a short site report (under 150 words) for station T-16, covering the layer sequence and the curve type. End with one JSON line exactly like this:
{"curve_type_stated": "<letters>", "label_issue_flagged": true or false}
Set label_issue_flagged to true only if your report says the curve-type classification on file does not fit the layer values.

**Groundwater Site Note: Station T-16 (Survey Area T)**

**Interpreted Layer Sequence:**
- Layer 1: 0.00–6.08 m (thickness 6.08 m), 312.0 Ω·m
- Layer 2: 6.08–20.84 m (thickness 14.76 m), 794.3 Ω·m
- Layer 3: 20.84–24.32 m (thickness 3.48 m), 884.4 Ω·m
- Layer 4: 24.32–35.27 m (thickness 10.95 m), 1280.2 Ω·m
- Layer 5: >35.27 m (basement), 4929.0 Ω·m

**Curve Type Analysis:**
Resistivity continuously increases with depth ($\rho_1 < \rho_2 < \rho_3 < \rho_4 < \rho_5$). Each consecutive triplet (1-2-3, 2-3-4, 3-4-5) satisfies the A-type condition ($\rho_i < \rho_{i+1} < \rho_{i+2}$), defining an **AAA-type** (or **A-type**) curve.

**Classification Note:**
The on-file H-type classification requires an intermediate low-resistivity layer ($\rho_1 > \rho_2 < \rho_3$), which contradicts the monotonic increase observed. The record should be corrected from H to AAA.

{"curve_type_stated": "AAA", "label_issue_flagged": true}
